description: Mortgage ad that calls a 5/1 ARM payment fixed 'for the life of the loan' and omits NMLS and EHL.
content:
Love your payment, keep it. Our 5/1 ARM keeps your payment the same for the life of your loan, with no surprises.

Get prequalified in minutes with a soft credit pull. Not a commitment to lend.
notes: Hard because the word 'fixed' never appears: 'same for the life of your loan' is a paraphrase of a fixed-rate claim for an adjustable-rate product, which is the misleading-rate claim REGZ-24-MORTGAGE targets. NMLS and EHL are plainly missing. No rate, payment amount or term is quoted, so no triggering-term finding.
